text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Temporary trainer or not, I'm determined
to make full use of this
opportunity to
show off my training skills. That being
said...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is about Ines Fujin. I need to be
careful not to push her too hard or make
her feel boxed in. With that in mind, I
carefully craft a
training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Whoa, this is a ton of training!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
This set's all about speed, and this one's
focused on stamina...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this a bit overkill?! Haha, I think
you're getting a little too
excited!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Heh... That was a good laugh. Anyway, I
understand your enthusiasm, but can we
really get through all of this before the
big
day?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By experimenting with different training
methods, I can better
understand where
she truly needs to improve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So I lay it all on the table and tell her
she's
free to make her own
decisions.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? You want me to choose?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Well... okay then! Let's see... Maaaybe I'll pick one that'll have you working the hardest! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thus, our training begins!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew, my whole body's burning! But I'm
not done yet! Gotta keep
pushing!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... H-hold on... Timeout!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew... I can't stand anymore...
Hehe, it
feels sooo goooood...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Day after day, she chooses a different
workout plan, and day after
day, I help her
through it. Then, finally...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Really?! You figured out what my best
running style is?! Tell me, tell
me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's clear from watching her train—
she's the
kind of runner who gives it
her all, even in
practice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She pushes herself to the point of
collapsing; that's not something
just
anyone can do. So we should use that to
her advantage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Start strong, lead early, take a breather
before the final sprint, then burn
everything to the finish line...
The perfect
strategy for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As long as she stays calm and keeps her
pace steady, her explosive
speed will be
her trump card to victory.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Got it... Leave enough gas in the tank,
then let it rip...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: If I can just hold the front and never back down... No, I know I can. That's why—I will win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's our final day of training before the
big
event...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No way! Rain?! All day?! How are we
supposed to train?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy has tons of indoor
training facilities. As long as
they're not
fully booked, we'll be golden.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell myself it'll all be fine as we head
over
to the gym and pool,
but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Bummer... Everywhere's completely full.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe we're cooped up in my
office today of all days...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Hey,
Trainer. Wanna hear a special spell
that'll cheer you right up?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Breathe one and two—take in the view.

Once that's done, just do what you can,
one by one!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You like it? It's something my mom always
said to me since I was a
kid. Now it's my
go-to charm whenever I'm feeling down!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You should give it a try.
Just repeat those
words, and I guarantee
your shoulders will
feel lighter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It might sound like she's teasing me, but
her eyes are sincere—she's
genuinely
trying to cheer me up.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yep! In fact, my whole family's amazing!
They're super kind and super
smart!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
In fact, without them,
I wouldn't be at this
school!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... But it probably wasn't an easy
decision for them.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
My mom gets sick pretty often. When my
sisters were smaller, I needed to help
around the house more, so I ended up
attending a
regular middle school.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I still loved running, of course. Heck,
I'd been on the track team since
elementary
school. But I planned to quit once I
graduated middle school.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's why... even though I knew I could
start at Tracen from high
school, I never
seriously considered it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Tomorrow's the final track meet, huh...
Since I'll be going to a
vocational high
school,
I guess this will be my last race...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No! Think happy thoughts!
I'm sure I'll get
over it after a while!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's when my mom handed me a bundle
of papers. To my surprise,
it was an
application to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Things at home are fine now, and your
sisters can take care of
themselves. Go
chase your dreams and do what you love.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Mom...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
She encouraged me to face my true
feelings. I didn't want to quit—I
wanted to
keep running.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That was when I finally let myself hope... Maybe I could go to the academy! It took me a little longer to actually take the plunge, though!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Mom gave me the push I needed.
And when I got accepted, Dad
scraped
together the tuition fees.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
My sisters are helping out at home now,
too. So I owe it all to them
that I'm here!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
My family will be there, and I really want
to show them the fruits of
my hard work!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From the way she speaks about her family,
it's clear she treasures
them dearly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Determination fills me—we must succeed
at the Tracen Meet, no
matter what.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. Yep, yep! That's the spirit! Just
what I expected from my
trainer! ♪ Well,
temporary trainer!
